posts.en:
dsh-learning-mode#plugin is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Learning Mode agent preset: a coding agent that teaches while coding — concrete scenario-grounded explanations, Socratic guidance, and TODO(你) practice blanks, modeled on Claude Code's Learning output style; installable via dsh plugin add (dsh-learning-mode on npm).

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-c19d8bcaf488e0d4d566.html
